resume_words_short: A bit shorter than usual (475–600) — you can expand the bullets.
resume_words_very_short: Much shorter than usual (475–600) — important experience may be missing.
resume_words_long: A bit longer than usual (475–600) — not critical, but you can tighten it.
resume_words_very_long: Much longer than usual — consider cutting the less relevant parts.
letter_words_ok: Healthy length (250–350 words, about half a page)
letter_words_short: A bit short (aim for 250–350) — add one more concrete result.
letter_words_very_short: Too short (aim for 250–350) — add a second example with numbers.
letter_words_long: A bit long (aim for 250–350) — cut what the resume already says.
letter_words_very_long: Too long — recruiters read about half a page. Cut it down.
